assets.observation: Twin-shaft cutting box, hopper, dual drives and under-frame discharge conveyor read as a primary shredder; the visible material zones are plausible.

Inclined bottle belt feeds a drum mill; the direct-coupled motor, skip and cullet are visible. Before: motor and mill used the same blue housing paint and visually merged. This was the one corrected mismatch.
Stainless body, bin lifter, feed hopper, packaging screw, skip, slurry pump and buffer tank are legible; no material mismatch was established.
Feeder, short belt, head shell, splitter and separated output bins read as an eddy-current separator; no new material mismatch was established.
Inclined screen drum, feed hopper, overs chute, fines conveyor and piles are recognizable; the visible machine paint is coherent.

finding.before: The named motor part used the same housing paint as the mill drum.
finding.after: The motor now uses the existing painted-steel parameter. The mill enamel remains independent.
